statement: As a Customer, I want to have my name, address and phone number recorded, so that my orders can be delivered to me and I can be contacted about them.
capability: to have my name, address and phone number recorded

acceptance_criteria.text: The system stores a name, an address and a phone number for every customer.
The system accepts a customer record that has no bank account.
A customer has at most one bank account.
Given a customer record that lacks a name, an address or a phone number, When the record is saved, Then the system rejects the record.
acceptance_criteria.given: a customer record that lacks a name, an address or a phone number
acceptance_criteria.when: the record is saved
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the record

statement: As a Customer, I want to have each product described by a name, a description, a price and an image, so that I can choose the products I want to order.
capability: to have each product described by a name, a description, a price and an image

acceptance_criteria.text: The system stores a name, a description, a price and an image for every product.
Given a product record that lacks a name, a description, a price or an image, When the record is saved, Then the system rejects the record.
acceptance_criteria.given: a product record that lacks a name, a description, a price or an image
acceptance_criteria.when: the record is saved
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the record

acceptance_criteria.text: The price of a product is stored as a decimal number.

statement: As a Customer, I want to submit an order for one or more products, so that my purchase is registered for fulfilment.
capability: to submit an order for one or more products

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a known customer and at least one order item that refers to an existing product, When the order is submitted with a payment method, Then the system registers an order with the submission date as its order date and the status pending.
acceptance_criteria.given: a known customer and at least one order item that refers to an existing product
acceptance_criteria.when: the order is submitted with a payment method
acceptance_criteria.then: the system registers an order with the submission date as its order date and the status pending

acceptance_criteria.text: Each order item records a quantity, a unit price and exactly one product, and belongs to exactly one order.
Each order belongs to exactly one customer, and a customer may have any number of orders.
The unit price of an order item is stored as a decimal number.

statement: As a Customer, I want to have an invalid order submission rejected, so that I find out at once that the order did not go through.
capability: to have an invalid order submission rejected

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a customer who is not known to the system, When an order is submitted for that customer, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
acceptance_criteria.given: a customer who is not known to the system
acceptance_criteria.when: an order is submitted for that customer
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the submission and registers no order

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order submission that contains no order item, When the order is submitted, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order submission that contains no order item
acceptance_criteria.when: the order is submitted
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the submission and registers no order

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order item that refers to a product that does not exist, When the order is submitted, Then the system rejects the submission and registers no order.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order item that refers to a product that does not exist
acceptance_criteria.when: the order is submitted
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the submission and registers no order

statement: As a Customer, I want to know the total amount of my order, so that I can check what I will be charged.
capability: to know the total amount of my order

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with one or more order items, When the order is registered, Then the system records a total amount for the order.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order with one or more order items
acceptance_criteria.when: the order is registered
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records a total amount for the order

acceptance_criteria.text: The total amount of an order equals the sum over its order items of quantity multiplied by unit price.
The total amount of an order is stored as a decimal number.

statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to decline a pending order, so that an order that will not be fulfilled is ended without being invoiced or shipped.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with the status pending, When OrderStaff declines the order, Then the system sets its status to closed.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order with the status pending
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff declines the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets its status to closed

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is not pending, When OrderStaff attempts to decline the order, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order whose status is not pending
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff attempts to decline the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a declined order, When an invoice is requested for the order, Then the system rejects the request.
acceptance_criteria.given: a declined order
acceptance_criteria.when: an invoice is requested for the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request

statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to mark a pending order as filled, so that the order can proceed to shipping and invoicing.
capability: to mark a pending order as filled

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with the status pending, When OrderStaff marks the order as filled, Then the system sets its status to filled.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order with the status pending
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff marks the order as filled
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets its status to filled

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order whose status is not pending, When OrderStaff attempts to mark the order as filled, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order whose status is not pending
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff attempts to mark the order as filled
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

acceptance_criteria.text: A filled order can next be set only to shipped or to paid.
The status of an order is always one of pending, filled, paid, shipped or closed.

statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to mark an order as shipped, so that the delivery of the goods to the customer is recorded.
capability: to mark an order as shipped

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with the status filled, When OrderStaff marks the order as shipped, Then the system sets its status to shipped.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order with the status filled
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff marks the order as shipped
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets its status to shipped

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with the status paid, When OrderStaff marks the order as shipped, Then the system sets its status to shipped.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order with the status paid
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff marks the order as shipped
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets its status to shipped

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order with the status pending or closed, When OrderStaff attempts to mark the order as shipped, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order with the status pending or closed
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff attempts to mark the order as shipped
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

statement: As an OrderStaff, I want to close a completed order, so that finished orders are no longer processed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order that has been both shipped and paid, When OrderStaff closes the order, Then the system sets its status to closed.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order that has been both shipped and paid
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff closes the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets its status to closed

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order that has been shipped but not paid, When OrderStaff attempts to close the order, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order that has been shipped but not paid
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff attempts to close the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order that has been paid but not shipped, When OrderStaff attempts to close the order, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order that has been paid but not shipped
acceptance_criteria.when: OrderStaff attempts to close the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

acceptance_criteria.text: The status of a closed order cannot be changed.

statement: As an Accountant, I want to issue an invoice for a filled order, so that the customer knows the amount to pay.
capability: to issue an invoice for a filled order

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order that has been filled and has no invoice, When the Accountant issues an invoice for the order, Then the system records an invoice with a date, a decimal amount, a payment method and the status issued.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order that has been filled and has no invoice
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant issues an invoice for the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records an invoice with a date, a decimal amount, a payment method and the status issued

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order that already has an invoice, When the Accountant attempts to issue another invoice for the order, Then the system rejects the request.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order that already has an invoice
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant attempts to issue another invoice for the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an order that has not been filled, When the Accountant attempts to issue an invoice for the order, Then the system rejects the request.
acceptance_criteria.given: an order that has not been filled
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant attempts to issue an invoice for the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request

acceptance_criteria.text: The status of an invoice is always either issued or paid.
The status of an invoice changes only from issued to paid.

statement: As a Customer, I want to pay an issued invoice, so that my order can be completed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an invoice with the status issued, When the Customer submits a payment against the invoice with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system records the payment with the status pending.
acceptance_criteria.given: an invoice with the status issued
acceptance_criteria.when: the Customer submits a payment against the invoice with a date, an amount and a payment method
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records the payment with the status pending

acceptance_criteria.text: Every payment method recorded for an order, an invoice or a payment is one of bank, card or cash.
The amount of a payment is stored as a decimal number.
The status of a payment is always one of pending, completed or failed.

statement: As a Customer, I want to submit a new payment after a previous payment has failed, so that I can still settle my invoice when a payment does not go through.
capability: to submit a new payment after a previous payment has failed

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an invoice whose most recent payment has the status failed, When the Customer submits a new payment against the invoice, Then the system records a separate payment with the status pending.
acceptance_criteria.given: an invoice whose most recent payment has the status failed
acceptance_criteria.when: the Customer submits a new payment against the invoice
acceptance_criteria.then: the system records a separate payment with the status pending

acceptance_criteria.text: A failed payment keeps the status failed when a new payment is submitted against the same invoice.
An invoice may have any number of payments.

statement: As an Accountant, I want to confirm a pending payment, so that the invoice and its order are recorded as paid.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment with the status pending, When the Accountant confirms the payment, Then the system sets the status of the payment to completed.
acceptance_criteria.given: a payment with the status pending
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant confirms the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets the status of the payment to completed

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a pending payment against an issued invoice, When the Accountant confirms the payment, Then the system sets the status of the invoice to paid.
acceptance_criteria.given: a pending payment against an issued invoice
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant confirms the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets the status of the invoice to paid

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an invoice that has just been set to paid, When the system records the change, Then the system sets the status of the order of that invoice to paid.
acceptance_criteria.given: an invoice that has just been set to paid
acceptance_criteria.when: the system records the change
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets the status of the order of that invoice to paid

acceptance_criteria.text: An order is never set to paid while its invoice is not paid.
Given a payment whose status is completed or failed, When the Accountant attempts to confirm the payment, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: a payment whose status is completed or failed
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant attempts to confirm the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

statement: As an Accountant, I want to reject a pending payment, so that a payment that did not go through is not counted as settling the invoice.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment with the status pending, When the Accountant rejects the payment, Then the system sets the status of the payment to failed.
acceptance_criteria.given: a payment with the status pending
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant rejects the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system sets the status of the payment to failed

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment with the status pending, When the Accountant rejects the payment, Then the status of its invoice and of its order remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: a payment with the status pending
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant rejects the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the status of its invoice and of its order remain unchanged

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a payment whose status is completed or failed, When the Accountant attempts to reject the payment, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.given: a payment whose status is completed or failed
acceptance_criteria.when: the Accountant attempts to reject the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged

statement: The system shall register a submitted order containing up to 50 order items and respond within 2 seconds for at least 95% of submissions under normal operating conditions.
The system shall support at least 200 concurrent users and at least 20 order submissions per second under normal operating conditions while meeting the response time of NFR-01.
The system shall be available for at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance announced at least 24 hours in advance.
The system shall resume accepting requests within 15 minutes after a server failure without losing any order, invoice or payment recorded before the failure.
The system shall authenticate every user before granting access to any customer, order, invoice or payment data, and shall reject 100% of unauthenticated requests.
The system shall allow only users holding the Accountant role to confirm or reject a payment, and shall reject the same request from any other user.
The system shall encrypt customer personal data and bank account numbers in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest.
The system shall record the user and the time of every status change of an order, an invoice or a payment, and shall retain these records for at least 12 months.
